description: A man in a white lab coat and gloves, seen from the chest up, holds up a translucent film printed with dark parallel horizontal bands and points at it with a gloved finger. Behind him a bright monitor or light box glows, and a shelf of bottles sits in the dark background. On the bench in front are a rack of small plastic sample tubes, a row of red-filled vials, pipettes and a flask with reddish liquid. The painting is an oil-style image with thick brushwork and fills the whole frame, with no visible text.
